summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'ARGOMENTI PREFERITI' (favorite categories) edit feature in Profile tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx). All 7 acceptance criteria PASS. Fresh anonymous signup (nickname pt178378737177) → 3-step onboarding with politica+sport → home → PROFILO tab. (1) prefs-section rendered between stats and 'STORICO VOTI'. Chips pref-chip-politica and pref-chip-sport both present with red bg rgb(255,59,48). (2) prefs-edit-button opens prefs-modal; prefs-cat-politica & prefs-cat-sport show red bg rgb(255,59,48) (selected), the other 5 (tv, musica, cinema, social, gossip) show white bg rgb(255,255,255) (unselected). (3) Untick prefs-cat-sport + tick prefs-cat-gossip + prefs-save → modal closes and prefs-section now shows exactly pref-chip-politica + pref-chip-gossip; pref-chip-sport is gone. (4) Full page reload keeps the same state (politica+gossip, no sport) — backend persistence confirmed. (5) Reopen modal, untick both → prefs-save → modal stays open, prefs-error shows text 'Scegli almeno una categoria'. (6) prefs-select-all first tap: all 7 category chips turn red (selected); second tap: all 7 return to white (unselected). No red-screen, no console errors surfaced.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx is 352 lines — under the 700-line limit, OK.
savePrefs sends the current user's age/sex/region alongside favorite_categories on PATCH /auth/me/profile — good (backend requires the full profile shape).
Empty-selection check is done client-side before the API call, so no wasted network round trip when user unticks everything.
allSelected uses useMemo on cats+editSel, correctly recomputes when cats loads asynchronously.
openPrefs seeds editSel from user.favorite_categories on each open — no stale state leakage between opens.
Modal uses animationType='slide' + transparent + onRequestClose — correct for Android hardware back.
seed_data_creation: One fresh anonymous user (nickname pt178378737177) with favorite_categories=[politica, gossip], age=30, sex=M, region=Lazio.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile prefs edit is fully functional. TestIDs: prefs-section, prefs-edit-button, pref-chip-<id> (visible chips on section), prefs-modal, prefs-modal-close, prefs-select-all, prefs-cat-<id> (politica, sport, tv, musica, cinema, social, gossip), prefs-error, prefs-save. Selected chip bg = rgb(255,59,48) (brandPrimary). Auth flow: auth-tab-anon + auth-anon-nickname-input + auth-submit-button. Profile tab is reached by tapping text 'PROFILO' (no tab testID in (tabs)/_layout.tsx — consider adding tabBarTestID). Backend PATCH /api/auth/me/profile requires full {age, sex, region, favorite_categories} payload.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validated a feature addition (not a bug). Feature works exactly as specified.
